categories.main_business_segments: Satellite Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the chemical industry focusing on the research, production, and sales of polypropylene, acrylic acid and esters, ethylene glycol, ethylene oxide, propylene oxide, and polyethylene. The company also develops functional chemicals, polymer new materials, and new energy materials, serving industries such as aerospace, automotive, electronics, healthcare, nutrition, sports, construction, and environmental management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies in light hydrocarbon processing and green manufacturing processes, including proprietary and patented catalyst technologies. It continuously innovates in production methods for HDPE, AA/AE, EO, EG, and SAP products, optimizing energy efficiency and product quality. The company also integrates digital transformation with AI and 5G-enabled smart manufacturing platforms to enhance operational efficiency and safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Satellite Chemical serves a diverse customer base across multiple sectors including aerospace, automotive, electronics and semiconductors, healthcare, nutrition, sports, construction, and environmental governance. Its products are sold domestically and internationally, with exports reaching over 160 countries and regions, establishing a global brand presence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major production bases in Jiaxing, Pinghu, and Lianyungang. It has expanded its international footprint through subsidiaries and offices in the United States, Singapore, and Hong Kong, actively developing overseas markets and global supply chains.
categories.supply_chain_position: Satellite Chemical operates as an integrated player in the midstream and downstream segments of the chemical supply chain. It controls the entire light hydrocarbon processing chain from raw material production to high-end chemical new materials, enabling full industry chain integration and value addition.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven development, investing heavily in R&D with a focus on catalysts, new energy materials, polymer new materials, and functional chemicals. It has established a future R&D center and collaborates with top universities to build a comprehensive innovation ecosystem. Emphasis is placed on overcoming key technology bottlenecks, achieving self-reliance in high-end materials, and advancing digital and intelligent manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical products including functional chemicals, polymer new materials, and new energy materials. The company uses a combination of direct sales and distribution channels domestically and internationally. It also gains income from derivative financial instruments used for hedging raw material price risks.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Satellite Chemical is a leading domestic integrated light hydrocarbon chemical company with a strong market position in high-end chemical materials. It competes with other major chemical producers in China and globally, leveraging its integrated supply chain, technological innovation, and product quality to maintain competitive advantages, especially in high-end polyethylene and acrylic acid derivatives.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 45.65 billion RMB, a 10% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about 6.07 billion RMB, up 26.8%. Total assets reached 68.3 billion RMB, growing 5.8%. The company maintains strong cash flow generation and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, reflecting a robust growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Satellite Chemical emphasizes high-quality, green, and innovative chemical products with integrated industry chain advantages. It offers differentiated, high-performance materials such as high-end polyethylene and polymer resins with superior properties and market premiums. The company’s commitment to sustainability, digital transformation, and technological leadership creates unique value for customers and strengthens its brand reputation globally.
